steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: US independent film is produced outside the major Hollywood studio system, typically with lower budgets, creative freedom and alternative approaches to narrative, representation and style. | Key Fact: Independent filmmaking often prioritises personal vision, artistic experimentation and social relevance over commercial considerations and mass audience appeal. | Key Fact: Key indie aesthetics include naturalistic performance, location shooting, handheld cinematography, non-linear narratives and ambiguous endings that challenge mainstream conventions. | Key Fact: The Sundance Film Festival, founded by Robert Redford in 1978, became the premier showcase for American independent film and a launchpad for indie careers and distribution.
